_note: Per-CVE NVD score-provenance watch (agent/tools/nvd-provenance.mjs). Filed 2026-10-14 after one feed batch carried five CNA-assigned high scores whose NVD records were all still unanalyzed. The event worth catching is a record flipping out of its CNA-only state: vulnStatus changing, an `nvd@nist.gov` metric appearing beside (or replacing) the vendor's, or a KEV add. Keyword search (disclosure-watch's NVD channel) cannot see any of those — the record already exists. Verified live at seed time, 2026-10-14 12:4x UTC+8.
